description: What an asset is worth right now, in USD, as a MEDIAN across several venues with its spread - not a single exchange's last trade. Use it to quote, to compare venues or to spot a dislocated market. Cuesta $0.02 por llamada, en USDC sobre Base (protocolo x402).

symbols.description: Comma-separated symbols, up to 20. Example: BTC,ETH,SOL (por defecto: BTC)
